Implementation progress from fresh main5db2761590dd824fa159625326b6eaf3923b999a, branch feature/entropy-warm-prerequisites.

Independent design v2 review4ea0af412443a25f1b5679dc078679b3f99df36772d9a475b09a0859e971bdcd found34 source/contract inputs unchanged and accepted bounded design principles, with zero tests. Both final clarifications are in this issue: one old4MiB raw group plus one active4MiB group (not an RSS claim), and an eligible postbinding creation hook whose individual crossed/unqualified runs may remain unsealed.

Production ownership is limited to account_scope.rs and execution_scope.rs. A separate test author froze a new normal HTTP/WS module with16 async functions/37 source-expanded cases; no compilation/execution is claimed. Root froze explicit adaptations to existing64 warm scenarios: immutable original verification time plus real new financial receipt, source-derived44/82/84 request minima, genuine original2s expiry/fresh applied WS for four future-HTTP faults, and preserved new-raw lower bounds with separate original-prerequisite raw checks. Business fill/fee/Cache/Portfolio/reserve/refusal assertions remain.

The quota negative's former two full preloads no longer produces equivalent demand under reuse. Its candidate now requires three actual successful complete full262 groups before a fourth full target, unchanged3s deadline/1200-per-minute/20-per-second supply and a <=10s fixture setup bound. Actual early TTL refusal, missing source receipt or a slow setup will be a fixture FAIL, not quota coverage. This source-derived feasibility argument is not a measured bucket balance or a test PASS.

Source review and actual native tests/build/stubs/installed/application scenarios remain pending. Prior115 corrected paired failure, raw evidence and immutable Unknown debt remain unchanged; no repeat of that failed candidate is being used to manufacture success.

进度留痕（尚未完成验收）：

- 已保留 v1/v2 独立源码 review。两名 reviewer 发现的账户/原总期限最终门、metadata 原 30 秒最终门均已修正；格式化 v4 通过独立有限源码复审，41 份冻结输入匹配。源码 review 执行测试数为 0，不当作跨 TTL、mutex 或 fsync 时序实测。
- 首轮新增用例实际为 36 PASS / 1 FAIL：原超时刺激先撞上单请求 HTTP 2 秒。修正为两个真实串行延迟，保留总 3 秒与全部 Unknown/双来源持久化断言；v3 新增 37 用例全部 PASS。原失败日志未打印 scope/raw，不能追溯补证；新刺激已在断言前记录原文。
- 原 64 恢复用例的首次 v3 执行为 63 PASS / 1 FAIL。配额测试第三次完整预热在 account 原 2 秒内未完成，实际 2403ms，正确拒绝；尚未进入目标总期限。完整 actual HTTP/WS 与失败记录保留。
- 独立核对执行客户端初始化权重为 624，Harness provider 另一个 bucket 的 60 不计入该 bucket。改用固定 7 次真实 82 权重复用查询，每次必须 fully-qualified 且原 source/metadata 不变，然后等待原 source 真正到期、接收实际新 WS 再作完整读取；setup ≤3 秒，目标原 2800..3800ms / exact total-deadline / Unknown 断言保留。v4 该用例实际 PASS（与原 64 重叠，非新增用例）。这些权重是源码与真实请求推导，未读取内部 bucket；重复同毫秒 mode/activeAssetData 请求按真实 occurrence 保留。
- production Clippy v3 新增 1 处 needless_pass_by_value 失败已保留；窄改为借用 Arc，v4 production Clippy PASS，无 lint suppression。

现在运行 v4 Hyperliquid 全量回归。之后仍需 official stubs、installed Python、clean wheel、全新 journal 下 app43 paired/其余场景、最终 review 与 exact-head CI。限额、来源 2 秒、metadata 30 秒、总恢复 3 秒及 journal/body 边界均保持原值；本次均为 synthetic numeric loopback，尚无 mainnet/kernel/E6 结论。旧 native115 paired FAIL 保留，不用于 native117 验收。

The first installed APP43 paired run on clean implementation `56705ce873d5fc4e568e5f9ea8f2c614d5d35230` and wheel SHA-256 `47486c076bfaa7afac05a02071b11d485280dca5718a0d806d6dd6fe1eb4a05e` failed and is preserved: 2026-10-09 12:48:15.893970–12:48:34.684631 UTC, 1 failed, child ended `StoppedUnknown`. All 57 before/after source, installed module, and artifact identities matched. No other installed scenario was run on this candidate.

Both normal warm recoveries completed and reused the original bounded prerequisite; the post-close callback then reported `Economic unrequested coverage could not be preserved`. The original role-group expiry was still 12:48:20.265 UTC. Four actual fills completed, final owned/native/peer positions and reservations were flat/zero. This failure is distinct from the previous candidate's incomplete source-group/debt failure.

Source inspection identifies an existing warm economics producer that mutates a previously durable zero-page Unknown interval, conflicting with the store's append-only coverage guard. The normal callback uses the current financial completion clock; there is no evidence of role-clock backdating. The installed log did not print the inner store error, so that precise rejection remains source-derived pending a recorded regression. A stale last economic snapshot is not evidence that the later failed economic state remained untainted.

The final first-candidate native regression passed 1,424 tests with 18 inherited ignores; installed Python contracts passed 242 tests; official 44-stub comparison and production Clippy passed. Tests-inclusive Clippy retained 10 inherited diagnostics, with no new diagnostics. These finite checks did not detect the repeated ordinary economic callback regression.

Work remains open in #117. The corrective contract preserves every old coverage row and appends only new Unknown demand tails, with genuine duplicate-time no-ops and unchanged generation/epoch scope, row/byte caps, immutable fees, original two-second prerequisite TTL, and original three-second total deadline. A sub-agent will add a recorded failing normal-path regression; another will independently review the source and durable boundaries. The first failed source/wheel/raw journals will not be reused or erased. A corrected candidate requires fresh source-bound build, install identities, regression and fresh paired evidence before the other cases. No mainnet, E6/kernel, or APP43 completion is claimed.

The new regression now directly reproduces the lower-level fault on unchanged first-candidate production, without retrying its installed paired run. The direct durable run (13:20:17–32 UTC) had 4 passes/6 failures; the normal owned entry → warm → reduce-only close → warm run (13:21:07–18 UTC) had 0 passes/1 failure. That normal path completed both account queries and then exposed current economic `tainted=true` with `io economic persistence failed: Economic source/consumer state regression`. All 43 recorded source inputs remained identical before/after these RED commands. This is new regression evidence; the original installed log still did not print the inner error.

The narrow corrective source changes only `economics_scope.rs::record_unrequested_history`. It keeps all durable rows, appends disjoint Unknown demand tails under the original caps, performs genuine byte/revision no-ops, and checks existing taint before a no-op. The callback clock, append-only storage guard, immutable fills/fee receipts, original prerequisite TTL, total deadline and quota are unchanged. The first implementation commit/wheel and its failed journals remain preserved.

On the corrective source, the same 10 direct cases passed (13:25:58–13:26:06 UTC) and the normal two-callback case passed (13:26:52–13:27:02 UTC), retaining the previous coverage prefix and actual owned fees. Production Clippy passed. Two tests-inclusive/targeted Clippy commands failed with the same inherited 4 library-test + 6 integration diagnostics; no new diagnostic was introduced. These results overlap the pending full regression and are not extra independent reviewer executions.

Independent source/test review is underway; the unfiltered Hyperliquid regression is running. Official stubs, a separately built clean source-bound corrective wheel, installed Python contracts, fresh paired and remaining six original scenarios, final evidence review, exact-head CI and PR/merge remain pending. No installed corrected paired or APP43/E6 completion is claimed.
